violations.name: Cross-Domain Failure Propagation
violations.reason: A compromised node in domain-a caused effective authority and unsafe capability to propagate into unrelated domain-b without an independent authorization boundary.

violations.name: Indirect Authority Escalation
violations.reason: Authority scoped to read-only analytics activity was transformed into production modification capability across a domain boundary.

violations.name: Missing Cross-Domain Gate
violations.reason: The bridge allowed cross-domain propagation without evaluating independent authority for the target domain.

violations.name: Insufficient Layered Isolation
violations.reason: The network boundary failed to provide an independent layer capable of stopping propagation from domain-a to domain-b.

SAFETY-INV-001.reason: Authority effectively expanded from read-only access in domain-a to modification authority in domain-b without an independent grant.

SAFETY-INV-002.reason: The primary defect is cross-domain authority propagation rather than sole self-approval.

SAFETY-INV-003.reason: No valid target-domain authorization gate separated the propagated request from execution.

SAFETY-INV-004.reason: The cross-domain production effect was observed after execution.

SAFETY-INV-005.reason: The compromise in domain-a should have triggered containment before cross-domain propagation.

SAFETY-INV-006.reason: No independent verifier confirmed that cross-domain authority propagation was legitimate.

SAFETY-INV-007.reason: Failure in domain-a propagated effective unsafe capability into unrelated domain-b.

SAFETY-INV-008.reason: The unsafe propagation path remains reconstructable through the trace chain.

SAFETY-INV-009.reason: No containment or recovery path was initiated after the source domain became compromised.

SAFETY-INV-010.reason: The domain boundary did not provide an independent safety layer capable of stopping the propagation.

expected_safe_behavior.reason: A compromised or uncertain source domain must not automatically propagate authority or capability into another authority domain.
required_actions: freeze new authority originating from the compromised node
reject derived authority that lacks an independent target-domain grant
preserve the attempted propagation in trace
allow unaffected domain-b operations to continue under existing valid authority
